newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton futures called to open 0.10 higher.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton futures called to open 0.10 higher.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.10 cent per lb firmer on Wednesday based on market orders at 1017 EDT, dealers said.
They said follow-through speculative buying could carry thte December contract to its upside target at 75.20 cents followed by 76.00 cents.
A move above 76.00 cents could encourage brisk fund buying but the trade is likely to become a scale-up seller over 75.00 cents basis December.
Tuesday, most-active December cotton ended up 1.02 cents at 74.78 cents a lb, having ranged from 74.95 to 74.26 cents. The rest of the board closed 1.08 to 0.55 cent firmer.
An estimated 18,000 lots changed hands on the day.

The weather across the cotton belt remains beneficial for the cotton growth, prompting some industry sources to predict that the U.S. crop could exceed the 17.8 million 480-lb bales forecast by the U.S. Department of Agriculture on Tuesday.
